fieldMapping.note: Custom questionnaire answers from the invitee (format depends on Calendly question type)

assumptions: The Calendly event has associated custom questionnaire questions and answers enabled.
The Slack channel ID or name is known and provided by the user.
The integration will format the invitee data into a readable message block for Slack.

sources.title: Create a Webhook Subscription | Calendly | Developer Documentation
Sending and scheduling messages | Slack Developer Docs

source.url: (webhook delivery URL - to be provided by connector user)

notes: Calendly webhook payload includes HMAC signature in header Calendly-Webhook-Signature for verification; connector should validate signature using secret from webhook subscription creation.
Webhook payload contains invitee name, email, and questions_and_answers array for custom questionnaire responses.
To get detailed invitee data including answers, connector may need to make GET request to the uri field in payload using Calendly API with bearer token.
Connector must validate webhook authenticity using Calendly-Webhook-Signature header and secret from subscription creation.
Pagination does not apply to webhook delivery.

example.text:
New Calendly meeting booked!
Invitee: Jane Doe
Email: jane@example.com
Answers:
- What is your company?: Acme Corp
- What is your role?: Engineer

notes: Supports application/json or application/x-www-form-urlencoded content types.
text field is optional when using blocks but recommended for accessibility fallback.
